description.value: Travelodge by Wyndham Cranbrook is a national-chain motel located on Cranbrook Street North in Cranbrook, BC, a hub community on the Kootenay cycling corridor. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar mid-range motel experience for travellers passing through the East Kootenay region. Cranbrook serves as a practical resupply and rest stop for cyclists on routes such as the Trans Canada Trail and Crowsnest Highway.
